title: Response to Comments of Pellegrino et al.
content: I thank Robert Pellegrino and his associates for taking the time to read my review (Doty (2025) and to put forward what they view are its four key arguments with which they disagree (Pellegrino et al. 2026). Aside from #1, these “key arguments” were not articulated by me as such and are overstated. A principal point of contention concerns the strength and nature of prediction, not prediction, per se. I am always amazed by how many titles appear in the chemical senses literature that loosely use the term predict.
